en.text:
Collecting <arc/>Ionic Traces grants 4% <arc/>Chaos Reach Super Energy.

While at 5 Stacks of <arc/>Bolt Charge or higher, after having sprinted for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants you a Stack of <arc/>Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.

<arc/>Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit. 
0.75 second cooldown between refunds. This can increase <arc/>Chaos Reach duration by up to ~120%.
